# MediaPipe model fixture

`portrait.jpg` comes from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/portrait.jpg and is used solely for model integration testing. It is not a participant observation or reference-distance measurement. The test runs the real Face Landmarker on this image; it does not exercise a physical camera. MediaPipe project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe (Apache-2.0 code; review upstream asset terms before redistributing fixtures outside research).
